name: DGTL Sunrise
description: dgtl-connector is a Grok Bot plugin that connects agents to marketing accounts the human already administers. No DGTL Sunrise account is required to start. Free local Google Analytics, Search Console, and Tag Manager run on the user machine (read and manage). Klaviyo is local on the same machine with a merchant-held private API key. Pro adds a hosted Ads and Meta gateway.

install.notes: No DGTL Sunrise account is required to start. Connect the account that owns the property when the plugin asks. Never paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.

authentication.free: Connect Google on the machine for GA4, Search Console, and Tag Manager (read and manage). Klaviyo uses a merchant-held private API key stored locally. Report bytes do not go through DGTL. Live edits need confirmation and are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.
authentication.pro: Polar license redeemed at the stamp host yields a license JWT. Google Ads and Meta calls use that JWT plus the user’s OAuth. The Google Ads developer token and Meta app secret stay on the Worker.
rules: Never paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.
Never invent metrics, rows, or insights the APIs did not return.
Live writes are confirm-gated where enabled; approve before a live edit or publish.
Do not treat plugin output as legal, compliance, or financial advice.

endpoints.purpose: Pro checkout entry (Polar). Do not invent alternate checkout URLs.
Redeem a Polar purchase into a license JWT
endpoints.auth: Polar redeem credentials as documented by the plugin

endpoints.purpose: Hosted Google Ads gateway (reads and confirm-gated writes)
Hosted Meta Ads gateway (reads and confirm-gated writes)
Exchange Meta OAuth code for tokens used with the gateway
endpoints.auth: OAuth exchange as documented by the plugin

endpoints.purpose: Optional hosted sGTM ingest route (keys). Not a v1 product promise on the marketing site.
endpoints.auth: keys as configured for that route

notes: TikTok stamp hop exists when Polar feature tiktok is minted.
Merchant Center, Google Business Profile, and Shopify are plugin-direct to Google or Shopify, not stamp.
Klaviyo is local on the user machine with a merchant-held private API key. Free. Not Pro. Not stamp.
Free GA4, Search Console, and Tag Manager traffic does not use stamp for report bytes.

capabilities.notes: Local on the user machine. List accounts and properties; property details, data streams, key events; run reports. Manage property settings the tools support (data streams, key events, custom definitions, Measurement Protocol secrets where enabled). Live edits need confirmation and are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.

capabilities.write: confirm-gated sitemap submit/delete when writes are enabled
capabilities.notes: Local. List sites; query search performance; inspect a URL; list and open sitemaps. Submit or delete sitemaps after confirmation. Edits are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.
Local. Inspect containers and manage tags, triggers, and variables. Publish after confirmation. Edits are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.
Hosted via stamp. Pro $19/mo. Developer token stays on the Worker. Details: /google-ads.

Hosted via stamp. Pro $19/mo. Meta app secret stays on the Worker. Reads include catalogs and catalog products. Writes include catalog create/batch products and Conversions API event upload when that path is enabled. Meta app access still applies.

capabilities.write: campaign status, catalogs, and Events API when access and entitlement allow
capabilities.notes: Stamp hop when the Pro TikTok entitlement is on. Reads include advertisers, campaigns, insights, and catalogs. Writes include campaign status, catalog create/upload/bind, and Events API tracking when TikTok access and that entitlement allow.

Plugin-direct Google. Not stamp. Reads: accounts, products, statuses, issues, data sources. Writes: create a data source; upsert or delete product inputs. Confirm-gated. Writes off by default until enabled on the install.
Plugin-direct Google. Not stamp. Some calls need Google’s Business Profile API access. Edit is not in this version.

capabilities.write: inventory adjust and product set when those write paths are enabled
capabilities.notes: Plugin-direct Shopify. Not stamp. Reads include publications, catalogs, and product feeds. Writes: inventory adjust and product set. Live changes need confirmation. Write paths are off until enabled on the install.

Local on the user machine. Merchant-held private API key (KLAVIYO_API_KEY or local store). Free. Not Pro. Not stamp. Read: account, profiles (sparse), lists, segments, flows, campaigns, metrics, catalog items/categories/variants, reviews. Edit: draft email campaign create; send an existing draft (explicit send confirmation); upsert profile; create event (backfill); upsert catalog items (capped). Never paste the API key into chat. Creating a draft does not send it.
